UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: A user's profile in the application.

uid.description: The unique identifier of the user.

name.description: The full name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

status.description: The status of the user's account.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the user was created.

completed_videos.description: A list of video IDs that the user has completed.

progress_percentage.description: The percentage of the course the user has completed.

sessionId.description: The current session ID of the user for multi-device detection.

ContactMessage.title: ContactMessage
ContactMessage.description: A message sent by a user through the support page.

email.description: The email address of the sender.

date.description: The timestamp when the message was sent.

read.description: Whether the message has been read by an admin.
